- wamo Start (company): 0% on the first €5,000 a month of local EU consumer card sales (campaign until 31 Dec 2026), then 0.85% on EEA consumer cards. Business, corporate and Amex cards are outside the allowance. Terminal: no upfront or monthly fee. Plan includes a business account.
- wamo Grow (company): 0% on the first €15,000 a month of local EU consumer card sales (campaign until 31 Dec 2026), then 0.85% on EEA consumer cards. Business, corporate and Amex cards are outside the allowance. Terminal: no upfront or monthly fee. Plan includes a business account.
- Revolut Business Terminal / Tap to Pay: Domestic and European consumer cards; commercial and international cards 2.6% + €0.02. Tap to Pay adds €0.08. Needs a Revolut Business account.
- myPOS Plus: Domestic and EEA consumer cards; other cards 2.49%.
- Viva.com Standard pricing: Domestic and EEA consumer cards, minimum €0.03 per payment. Tap to Pay on iPhone and Android, so no hardware needed.
- SumUp Payments Plus: 1.29% on EEA debit and credit cards; Amex and premium cards 2.75%. Pays off above about €2,600 a month.
- myPOS Pro: Domestic and EEA consumer cards; other cards 2.49%.
- myPOS One: Domestic and EEA consumer cards; other cards incl. Amex 2.69%. Instant settlement to your myPOS account.
- Stripe Terminal: Standard in-person rate for EEA cards; BBPOS WisePad 3 reader from €59 excl. VAT. Best for businesses that also sell online.
- SumUp Pay as you go: Same 2.75% on every card; reader is a one-off cost (Solo Lite, excl. VAT).
